title: Chicago Shot Of Art After Dark Private Experience
includes: Per 2 persons - one canvas 16*20 Per 3 persons - one canvas 24*24 Per 4 persons - one canvas 24*36
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
SHOOTING&SPINNING IS ALLOWED FROM 18 YEARS OF AGE. In case it is a group, everyone must be 18+

Experience the enchantment of Shot of Art - After Dark, where creativity meets nightlife in a truly unique way. Step into our atmospheric setting and let your imagination run wild as you paint and create amidst the evening glow.

Our signature Shooting/Spinning activity adds an exhilarating twist to your artistic journey. Armed with an airsoft gun, you'll aim at balloons filled with vibrant paint, unleashing a burst of color onto your canvas. Then, watch in awe as we spin your paint-splashed masterpiece into a stunning abstract work of art, creating mesmerizing patterns and textures.

Ideal for date nights or group outings, Shot of Art - After Dark promises an unforgettable experience filled with creativity, laughter, and excitement. Embrace the magic and let your inner artist shine!

Please note: This activity is suitable for ages 18 and above.
